answer: Reaching the terrace of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Work waits on the comet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ember of the next round. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, no identity may audit its own recruit. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
